author: Lakhman
body:
Hello Avic.us staff reading this,
                                      
                            I have been falsely banned for Team Griefing.

                         All i wanted to do was place an enchantment table somewhere else where there were bookshelves, and we could enchant higher levels.I thought we could do that because we could break the Enchantment tables so i thought i was not punishable. Then however, i got simply Banned.

                    I know i did the wrong thing now, but before i never knew i could not do it!

                                                                IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!

                Please can you guys un-ban me? i promise i will never replace the enchantment table again.

title: Being banned for Team Griefing

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello zStrqfingKinqs_,

Please be aware that you did not get banned for teamgriefing. You only received a kick for this. You were banned for ban evasion. 

Also, seeing as you made two appeals. I will be replying to you concerning your ban on your other appeal.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez | Jessica
